# PS5LM

> llama.cpp on a jailbroken PS5: the app loads a GGUF model onto the console's RDNA 2 GPU through llama.cpp's
> Vulkan backend and serves it to every device on the network over OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Decision models
> (d1, Clef) answer Ollaya's `/v1/systemone`. Open source, GPL-3.0, title ID PPSA99575.

Key facts:

- The console answers on `http://<console>:8081` once the app's Home screen says Ready. The model name in a request
  is ignored: the loaded model answers, so any name works.
- Endpoints: `/v1/chat/completions` (OpenAI Chat Completions), `/v1/responses` (codex), `/v1/messages` (Anthropic,
  Claude Code), `/v1/systemone` (decision models), and a chat page at `/` in any browser.
- Claude Code: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://<console>:8081 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=ps5lm ANTHROPIC_MODEL=ps5
  ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL=ps5 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=65536 claude`.
- Needs a PS5 on firmware 7.00 to 13.60 with kstuff-lite, etaHEN and ShadowMountPlus; elfldr and ftpsrv are
  recommended. Models live in `/data/PS5LM/models` or `PS5LM/models` on a USB drive.
- Measured on a PS5 Slim: Qwen 3.5 9B Q4_K_M at 55 tokens a second, Qwen 3.8 27B UD-Q2_K_XL at about 20 with a
  64k context, d1 Omni 600M answers three questions in 0.3 s. About 11 GB of model and context fits.
